s12_p3.interpretation: R9 recovers all 9 PS_048 source directions. RQ1 plant-balanced primary 0.009723604857785641 vs R9 0.007921538431514311 (difference -0.0018020664262713305). R9 remains a sensitivity arm, not a new primary protocol.

interpretation.text: Offset correction reduces plant-balanced OTG from 0.009723604857785641 to 0.0041222054933101855 (PB Delta_OTG 0.005601399364475456; 53/85 directions improve, 32/85 worsen). Affine correction reduces it further to -0.000946480273195094 (PB Delta_OTG 0.010670085130980736; 61/85 improve, 24/85 worsen), moving fleet-level plant-balanced OTG slightly below zero. RQ2 plant-balanced |A| is 0.026622430133826737 (k=0), 0.015496536535324687 (k=1), 0.01175731889409727 (k=2) on 38 same-level pairs. Median |delta| 0.027402493349015244; median |b-1| 0.061955366855692695. The ratio 1 - PB_OTG_k2/PB_OTG_k0 = 1.0973384137917999 is not a share of penalty removed: PB_OTG_k2 is negative, so the ratio overshoots 1. Headline comparisons use absolute plant-balanced OTG and Delta_OTG, not that ratio.
descriptors: offset correction removes a substantial portion of the fleet-level residual penalty
affine correction adds substantial reduction beyond offset and moves plant-balanced OTG slightly below zero
response remains heterogeneous because nontrivial sets of directions worsen under both corrections

sampling.note: 1024 is sampling sensitivity only; 2048 is headline

association_stability_1024_vs_2048.conclusion: Under the 1024 cap, ED_full vs retention remains strongly negative (rho_2048=-0.8744576900527653, rho_1024=-0.8607777994918898); ED_supported vs |OTG| remains small (rho_2048=0.08960328317373462, rho_1024=0.0813171780340043); partial Spearman remains modestly negative (rho_2048=-0.29246274566286823, rho_1024=-0.30366685086475015). The qualitative P9 conclusions — mismatch tracks support loss; residual distance does not clearly add beyond retention — are stable under the smaller cap. No magnitude cutoff was applied.

scientific_consequence.q1: Environmental mismatch is associated with support loss and/or residual OTG only to the extent of the reported Spearmans; it does not by itself fully explain nonzero twin OTG.
scientific_consequence.q2: Partial Spearman CI includes zero or is weak: residual environmental distance does not clearly add information beyond support retention.
scientific_consequence.q3: RQ2 signed environmental asymmetry vs signed OTG is descriptive only (n=38 pairs, shared plants): rho=-0.2846044424991793, concordance={'n_nonzero': 38, 'n_concordant': 18, 'fraction': 0.47368421052631576}.
scientific_consequence.q4: Environmental distance is not sufficient as a standalone source-selection rule on this evidence; it may complement retention diagnostics but is not a deployment criterion by itself.

rq4_source_selection.rq4_wording: RQ4 — How much target-side verification data are needed to select a source model whose future transfer error is close to the best available source, and when does the remaining selection regret become no larger than the temporal instability of the future source ranking itself?
rq4_source_selection.dataset: canonical BR-PVGen analytical data in project SoT
rq4_source_selection.target_cohort: protected confirmatory cohort from project partition artifact; reconstruct and hash-verify
rq4_source_selection.source_cohort: authorized development/source population; freeze IDs+hash before confirmatory scoring
rq4_source_selection.support_definition: CS4 source TRAIN; kNN=5; threshold=0.95 quantile of LOO 5th-neighbour distances
rq4_source_selection.regret_relative_definition: Reg_abs / L_star(R) if L_star finite and >0; no epsilon
rq4_source_selection.metadata_baseline_definition: expected regret under uniform min-Gower ties at k=0
rq4_source_selection.noise_floor_definition: mean of A→B and B→A regret on alternating 7-day blocks inside R
rq4_source_selection.T1: target-balanced mean Delta_meta = Reg_random - Reg_metadata; 95% target-cluster bootstrap
rq4_source_selection.T2: target-balanced mean Delta_verify = Reg_metadata - Reg_45; k fixed at 45
rq4_source_selection.T3: persistent k_tau: earliest k with upper95CI(median Reg_rel(k)) <= tau for that k and all later k
rq4_source_selection.T4: persistent k_noise: earliest k with upper95CI(median ExcessNoise(k)) <= 0 for that k and all later k
rq4_source_selection.claim_guardrails: conditional on BR-PVGen fleet, frozen cohorts, horizon, CS4; no universal-day or causal claims

cohort_resolution.source_population_provenance: P02C_PLANT_SUMMARY plants minus PRIMARY_SCOPE confirmatory targets

T1.rule: claim only if CI fully above zero
